summary: Scale EDA up or down by editing [automationeda] hosts with eda_type=api or worker and routable_hostname, then rerunning the installer.
questions: How do I add worker nodes to EDA controller?
Inventory example for EDA worker nodes

answer_card.title: Add EDA worker nodes
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[automationeda]
3.88.116.111 routable_hostname=automationeda-api.example.com eda_type=api
3.88.116.112 routable_hostname=automationeda-api.example.com eda_type=worker
3.88.116.113 routable_hostname=automationeda-api.example.com eda_type=worker
```
Then rerun the installer.
